def fit_period(v,p):
    # majority/most common symbol in each residue, fill ties by first observed
    pat=[]
    for r in range(p):
        vals=[v[i] for i in range(r,len(v),p)]
        from collections import Counter
        cnt=Counter(vals)
        pat.append(cnt.most_common(1)[0][0])
    pred=[pat[i%p] for i in range(len(v))]
    return sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(v,pred)),pat,pred
